notes_for_editor: Only web source is the OSM node. Two searches and the cached NHLR and FFLOS PA indexes found no page for this tower, so no build year, builder, height, staffing or access. The record's status 'standing' is unverified. A local GNIS file (data/sources/peaks_gnis.json, not cited) has a named summit 'Lost Mountain' about 30 m from the node. The local storymap cache (data/raw/pa_storymap) has a 1923 Blaw-Knox Huntingdon County Rothrock entry, but it sits under the 'Jacks Mountain' heading, so it is not attached here. Next: Pennsylvania DCNR Rothrock district records or local newspaper archives.
